args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Quick note on the PHL label confusion.

- Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- Moss's 18 May coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- The old label makes the receiving supervisor search twice. Moss added a report-label change to the handoff list.
- Related: ticket PD-4821 (door 6 showing available during the Tuesday maintenance block).
- The "PHL" shorthand also appears in port-logistics search results. To separate them: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Ask: rename the saved report to the current Pellow Home Living name, and confirm whether any other saved items still use "Covey".

Thanks,
Bettina
